pages.title: Scrob Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to Scrob: what it is, its architecture, key features, and how the major subsystems relate. Links to child pages for deeper coverage.

pages.title: Getting Started & Deployment
pages.purpose: How to deploy Scrob using Docker Compose (standard and Omnibus), environment variables, first-time setup, and updating. Covers both multi-container and single-container deployment models.

pages.title: Configuration Reference
pages.purpose: Comprehensive reference for all environment variables, database connection pool tuning, SMTP, OIDC, and application-level settings managed via pydantic-settings.

pages.title: Backend Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of the FastAPI backend: application entrypoint, background schedulers, router organization, database layer, and shared dependencies. Links to child pages for each major subsystem.

pages.title: Application Entrypoint & Background Tasks
pages.purpose: Details of backend/main.py: FastAPI app initialization, lifespan events, background schedulers (_auto_sync_scheduler, _emby_progress_poller, _watchlist_poller, _show_status_refresher), and rate limiting middleware.

pages.title: Database Layer & Models
pages.purpose: SQLAlchemy async engine setup, session management, connection pool tuning, Alembic migrations, and the full ORM model registry (User, Media, Show, WatchEvent, Collection, etc.).

pages.title: Authentication & Authorization
pages.purpose: User registration, login, JWT session management, TOTP 2FA, OIDC/SSO, OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628), API key access, and FastAPI dependency injection for auth enforcement.

pages.title: Data Schemas & API Contracts
pages.purpose: Pydantic schemas defining request/response shapes: User, UserSettings, MediaServerConnectionBase, WatchEventCreate, and how the frontend api.ts client maps to these contracts.

pages.title: Media Metadata & Discovery
pages.purpose: Overview of how Scrob fetches, enriches, and serves media metadata from TMDB and TVDB. Links to child pages covering the metadata pipeline, search/discovery, and show/episode management.

pages.title: TMDB & TVDB Integration
pages.purpose: The TMDB API client (tmdb.py), TTL cache, circuit breaker, enrichment pipeline (enrichment.py), TVDB fallback for unmatched episodes, and the create_media_safely concurrency pattern.

pages.title: Media Router: Collection, Search & Discovery
pages.purpose: The /media API router: collection listing with filters, multi-source search, trending/on-air/hidden-gems rails, the For You recommendation engine, and the enrich_with_state pipeline.

pages.title: Shows, Seasons & Episode Order
pages.purpose: The /shows API router: show detail aggregation, TVDB routing, episode order mapping (TMDB vs TVDB), EpisodeOrderMapping reconciliation, orphaned episode adoption, and show metadata refresh.

pages.title: Playback, Streaming & Subtitles
pages.purpose: Playback source resolution (CollectionFile → server instance), video stream proxying from Plex/Jellyfin/Emby, SRT-to-WebVTT subtitle conversion, and HLS player support.

pages.title: Watch History & Playback Tracking
pages.purpose: Overview of how Scrob records, manages, and queries user watch history, playback sessions, and progress. Links to child pages for history management and scrobbling.

pages.title: Watch Events & History Management
pages.purpose: The /history API router: marking watched/unwatched, bulk season/show marking, watch event deletion with fan-out, Next Up calculation, Continue Watching, rate prompts, and dropped media.

pages.title: Playback Sessions & Scrobbling
pages.purpose: PlaybackSession lifecycle (start/update/complete), deterministic session keying, auto-completion at 90% threshold, manual scrobble UI, echo suppression, and the now-playing poller.

pages.title: Rewatch Cycles
pages.purpose: The ShowRewatch sub-system: starting a rewatch cycle, RewatchProgress tracking, how rewatch state overrides global WatchEvent history for Next Up and watch percentage calculations.

pages.title: Synchronization Engine
pages.purpose: Overview of Scrob's bidirectional sync architecture: pull (inbound) and push (outbound) pipelines, SyncJob lifecycle, fan-out mechanism, and the semaphore-locked sync loop. Links to child pages per provider.

pages.title: Jellyfin & Emby Sync
pages.purpose: Jellyfin and Emby library sync: the core API client (jellyfin.py/emby.py), pagination, TMDB ID resolution, watched state push/pull, rating sync, recently-added ordering, and the Emby progress poller.

pages.title: Plex Sync
pages.purpose: Plex library sync: server vs account token, watch history backfill, PlexPendingPush echo protection, language backfill, Plex Watchlist reconciliation, and the Plex Discover/Community API.

pages.title: Webhook Ingestion (Real-Time Scrobbling)
pages.purpose: Webhook endpoints for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, and Kodi: payload parsing/normalization, media identification lifecycle (fast path → external ID → fuzzy match → TVDB translation), deduplication, and in-memory echo suppression.

pages.title: Trakt Synchronization
pages.purpose: Trakt OAuth device flow, incremental and full pull sync, push pipeline with rate limiting, Trakt export ZIP import, list reconciliation, and the LiveTraktSource/ExportTraktSource adapter pattern.

pages.title: Simkl, MDBList & Other Cloud Services
pages.purpose: Simkl PIN auth and bidirectional sync, MDBList watchlist pull and rating push, Nuvio/ARVIO cloud sync, Stremio watched bitfield decoding, Bingebase integration, and ratings fan-out.

pages.title: Frontend Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of the Astro-based frontend: SSR rendering model, layout system, global event bus, theme/accent system, and the API proxy layer. Links to child pages for pages and components.

pages.title: Layout, Theming & Global Interactions
pages.purpose: Base.astro as the application shell: theme initialization (dark/light/accent), FOUC prevention, the data-action event delegation hub, DOM sync functions (updateWatchedButtonUI, syncSeasonWatchPctFromDOM), now-playing poller, and global.css design system.

pages.title: Dashboard & Discovery Pages
pages.purpose: The index.astro dashboard (hero, recently added, continue watching, next up, trending rails), the discover page, search, airing-today, trending pages, and the hybrid SSR+client-side data fetching strategy.

pages.title: Media Detail Pages
pages.purpose: Movie and episode detail pages (media/[type]/[id].astro), show/season/episode hierarchy pages (show/[id].astro, show/[id]/season/[n].astro), TVDB-routed variants, ActionBar component, EpisodeOrderSelector, and metadata refresh flow.

pages.title: UI Components Library
pages.purpose: Reusable Astro components: MediaCard, EpisodeCard, HistoryCard, ContinueWatchingCard, ActionBar, CardActionBar, ListCard, MediaRow, SyncStatus, FilterPanel, SortButton, CommentsSection, and ManualScrobble.

pages.title: Collection, History & List Pages
pages.purpose: Collection pages (movies/shows), watch history page, list detail page ([id].astro) with search-and-add, Radarr/Sonarr compat URLs, next-up page, dropped page, calendar page, and stats/profile pages.

pages.title: User Management & Administration
pages.purpose: Overview of user accounts, settings, connections, admin panel, and social features. Links to child pages for connections management, admin operations, and user profiles.
